title: COLT LITE SADDLEBAGS 54L
description:
The Colt Lite Saddlebags 54L are built for riders who need ample storage without feeling overloaded. Designed for adventure and sports touring, the saddlebags use a structured shape, adjustable centre bridges, quick-access storage, rain covers, and internal drybags to keep luggage organised and ready for changing ride conditions

VOLUME AND COMPARTMENTS

  • Cargo Volume: 54L total, 27L each side
  • Main Compartments: Two main saddlebag compartments for clothing and ride essentials
  • Quick-Access Pockets: 2 front quick-access pockets for smaller items
  • Internal Drybags: 2 internal drybags included

MOUNTING MECHANISM

  • Recommended Use: Ideal for motorcycles with upswept silencers
  • Centre Bridges: 2 broad adjustable centre bridges
  • Bridge Adjustment: Double-D ring mechanism
  • Frame-To-Bag Mounting: 2 frame-to-bag mounting straps included
  • Tail Tidy Mounting: 1 tail tidy mounting strap included

title: TURTLE 2 TANK BAG 24L
description:
Cramster Turtle Tank Bag is the all-in-one solution for motorcyclists who love to travel light, with only one bag. It packs serious utility into a sleek, compact design, offering universal compatibility for all types of motorcycles.

Construction

  • Heavy-duty 600D fabric with 1680D polyester trims
  • Straps along with 5 strong monopole removable magnets, for a firm grip and effortless mounting or unmounting
  • Anti-skid, scratch-proof base keeps the tank bag secure and the tank free from marks
  • Genuine 3M Reflective panels for increased visibility
  • Genuine YKK Zippers

Volume

  • Volume: 18 Litres
  • Expandable Volume: 24 Litres
  • 2 easy-access side secured zipper pockets to keep essentials
  • Transparent touchscreen-friendly pocket for a smart device
  • Internal mesh pocket

Mounting Mechanism

  • Metal Tank: Mount as a tank bag with straps along with magnets
  • Non-metal Tank: Mount as a tank bag with straps
  • Tail bag: Mount as a tail bag with straps
  • Backpack: Transforms into a backpack with back straps

More Features

  • Elasticated cargo net to stuff gloves into when taking a break or fueling up
  • Compression straps inside the main compartment for better storage organisation
  • Convenient carry handle for short-distance hauling

Read Before Use

  • Always use the strap mounting system.
  • The magnets are for quick, light-duty mounting on steel tanks only.
  • For any real load, highway speeds, or rough roads, the straps are what keep the bag on, even on metal tanks.
  • A tank bag that comes loose at speed is a hazard to you and others.
  • Mount it right. Ride safe.

title: FLUX MOTORCYCLE TOURING BOOTS
description:
Experience the perfect combination of protection, durability, and comfort with the Cramster Flux Motorcycle Touring Boots. Whether you're tackling rough terrains or cruising the highways, these boots are designed to meet the demands of every adventure. Get yours today and ride with confidence!


IMPACT PROTECTION

  • TPU Heel Counter: Provides enhanced safety and stability, protecting your feet from impacts
  • TPU Toe Cap: Shields your toes from potential hazards on the road
  • Orthopaedic Insole: Provides additional comfort by absorbing shocks
  • Foam Padded Shin Protection: Cushions and protects your shins from impacts and abrasions
  • Cerros Ankle Protector: Offers superior protection for your ankles, enhancing overall safety

 

ABRASION RESISTANCE

  • Genuine Leather: Durable and resistant to wear and tear, ensuring long-lasting performance
  • Gear Shift Protector: Reinforced Microfiber Patch for enhanced durability and abrasion resistance
  • Reinforced Dual Stitching: Provides extra strength and durability, ensuring your boots withstand the toughest conditions

 

VENTILATION

  • Breathability: Keeps your feet cool and comfortable by allowing air circulation
  • Water-Resistant Lining: Ensure your feet remain dry in light showers

 

COMFORT AND FIT

  • Orthopaedic Gel-Padded Insoles: Offer superior cushioning and shock absorption for all-day comfort
  • YKK® Zipper Fasteners: Ensure quick and easy access, making it simple to put on and take off your boots
  • Stretch Accordion Panels: Provide enhanced flexibility and comfort, both on and off the bike
  • Lightweight Design: Ensures ease of movement without compromising on protection
  • Rugged, Bi-Directional Anti-Slip Rubber Sole: Offers superior grip and stability on various surfaces, ensuring safety and confidence in every step
  • Retro-Reflective Panels: Enhances visibility at night, ensuring you are seen by other road users

 

Wash & Care

  • Cleaning
    Surface Cleaning: Brush off dirt and debris after each use. For stains, wipe with a damp cloth
    Deep Cleaning: Use a mild soap solution and a soft cloth. Avoid soaking the boots
    Drying: Air-dry at room temperature. Avoid direct heat sources. Stuff boots with newspaper to maintain shape
  • Maintenance
    Leather Care: Apply leather conditioner for suede and leather. Avoid harsh chemicals
    Microfiber Upper: Clean gently with a damp cloth
    Zippers and Fasteners: Keep clean and lubricate occasionally
  • Storage
    Dry Environment: Store in a cool, dry place. Use a boot tree or stuff with paper
    Ventilation: Let boots air out after each ride
    Avoid Heavy Objects: Do not place heavy items on top
